title: Companion visual review feedback
description: Opens a run's Ready Gate visual-review source in Companion, walks the Ready Gate parent and its Evidence, Diff, and Timeline children with a draft in progress, drives every touch annotation control, and sends the feedback to the originating run's worker, reading the run back from the gateway to prove nothing was resolved. Run after a Ready Gate catalog recipe has published visual-review-source.json into the run's artifacts.

expected_delivery.description: Outcome the chosen run produces: accepted when its worker session is live, failed when the gateway refuses the send (for example, no runner context).

proofTargets.claim: The Ready Gate parent lists Evidence, Diff, and Timeline subscreens, and moving between them keeps the draft.
An overall note plus colored point and area annotations can be added, selected, moved, edited, and removed by touch.
Sending renders the delivery outcome for the originating run, keeps the draft, and resolves nothing.

open-review.cmd: url="farmslot-development:///visual-review/{{params.run_id}}"; if [ "$PLATFORM" = ios ]; then xcrun simctl openurl "$IOS_SIMULATOR" "$url"; else adb -s "$ADB_SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "$url" "$FARMSLOT_RECIPE_APP_ID"; fi
open-review.intent: Open the run's visual review the same way a shared review link does.

wait-loaded.intent: The source loaded and its surface list includes the Ready Gate.

open-parent.intent: Open the Ready Gate from the surface list; the source opens on its root surface.

wait-parent.intent: The Ready Gate parent lists its first subscreen.

wait-parent-diff.intent: The parent lists the Diff subscreen.

wait-parent-timeline.intent: The parent lists the Timeline subscreen.

capture-parent.label: Ready Gate parent with subscreens
capture-parent.intent: Record the parent surface, its subscreen chips, and its capture.

reveal-note.intent: Reach the Ready Gate overall note below its full-height capture.

write-note.value: Summary card is too dense on a phone.
write-note.intent: Leave overall feedback on the parent surface.

dismiss-note.intent: Done closes the keyboard without adding a line break.

top-from-note.intent: Scroll back toward the surface navigator.

top-from-note-modes.intent: Reach the surface list above the Ready Gate capture without touching it.

open-evidence.intent: Move from the parent to its first subscreen.

wait-evidence.intent: The subscreen links back to its Ready Gate parent.

reveal-canvas.intent: Bring the Evidence capture into view below the navigator.

add-point.intent: Drop a point annotation on the capture in the default tap mode.

wait-point.intent: The new point marker renders on the capture and is selected for editing.

reveal-editor.intent: Show the selected point editor under the capture.

describe-point.value: Status badge overlaps the run title.

dismiss-point-comment.intent: Done closes the keyboard so the colour and nudge controls are reachable.

recolor-point.intent: Change the selected point to the orange review color.

nudge-point.intent: Move the selected point one step with the touch nudge control.

wait-nudged.intent: The nudge moved the point by one step from the tapped center.

capture-point.label: Point added, described, and recolored
capture-point.intent: Record the selected, recolored point with its comment.

reveal-marker.intent: Bring the edited point back into view on the capture.

drag-point.intent: Drag the selected point to a new spot on the capture.

wait-position-shown.intent: Keep the point position readout on screen so its change is checked, not assumed.

wait-dragged.intent: The drag moved the point: its old 52% position is gone from the screen tree.

wait-editor-open.intent: The dragged point stays selected, so the changed position belongs to it.

capture-moved.label: Point moved by drag
capture-moved.intent: Record the point at its dragged position.

reveal-modes.intent: Scroll back to the annotation mode controls above the capture.

area-mode.intent: Switch the canvas to area drawing.

draw-area.intent: Drag across the capture to mark an area.

wait-area.intent: The area annotation renders and is selected for editing.

capture-area.label: Area drawn on the Evidence capture
capture-area.intent: Record the point and the selected area together.

reveal-area-editor.intent: Show the new area editor; area mode claims drags on the capture, so the page moves from the controls above it.

describe-area.value: Group these rows under one heading.

dismiss-area-comment.intent: Done closes the keyboard after the area comment.

select-point.intent: Select the point again from the annotation list.

reveal-remove.intent: Show the Remove control for the selected point.

reveal-removed.intent: Bring the capture back into view so the removal is checked on screen, not just off it.

wait-removed.intent: The removed point is gone while the area remains.

wait-area-kept.intent: Removing one annotation leaves the other untouched.

top-from-evidence.intent: Scroll back toward the surface navigator.

top-from-modes.intent: Reach the surface list above the Evidence capture.

open-diff.intent: Move to the Diff sibling through the surface list.

wait-diff.intent: Diff also links back to the Ready Gate parent.

open-timeline.intent: Move to the Timeline sibling through the surface list.

back-to-parent.intent: Return to the Ready Gate parent from a subscreen.

point-mode.intent: Leave area mode so a drag over the capture scrolls the page again.

reveal-delivery.intent: Show the overall note, draft totals, and send controls below the capture.

text_contains: Summary card is too dense on a phone.
wait-note-kept.intent: The parent's overall note survived the round trip through its subscreens.

capture-kept.label: Draft kept after subscreen navigation
capture-kept.intent: Record the parent with its note and per-surface feedback counts.

wait-summary.intent: The draft holds one parent note and the Evidence area.

snapshot-run-before.intent: Record the run's status and decisions from the gateway before sending feedback.

send.intent: Send the portable feedback document to the originating run's worker.

wait-outcome.intent: The worker-input outcome is rendered for the originating run.

wait-draft-after-send.intent: Sending keeps the draft, whatever the outcome.

capture-outcome.label: Delivery outcome with draft kept
capture-outcome.intent: Record the delivery status next to the retained draft counts.

verify-run-unchanged.cmd: FARMSLOT_GATEWAY="${FARMSLOT_GATEWAY:-ws://localhost:${GATEWAY_PORT}/ws}" node ../command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway run.get '{"runId":"{{params.run_id}}"}' > "$FARMSLOT_RECIPE_ARTIFACTS_DIR/run-after-send.json" && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const d=process.argv[1];const view=(f)=>{const {run}=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(d+"/"+f,"utf8"));return JSON.stringify({status:run.status,decisions:(run.decisions||[]).map(({id,resolvedAt,resolvedAction})=>({id,resolvedAt,resolvedAction}))});};const before=view("run-before-send.json"),after=view("run-after-send.json");if(before!==after)throw new Error("run changed after feedback: "+before+" -> "+after);console.log("RUN_UNCHANGED_AFTER_FEEDBACK")' "$FARMSLOT_RECIPE_ARTIFACTS_DIR"
verify-run-unchanged.intent: The gateway still reports the same run status and unresolved decisions after the feedback was sent.
